resolution.note: SessionStart injects the Resume and Operator requests block; handoff-requests refuses missing Task, SHAs, Verify

title: Inject one consolidated handoff block and verify first at session start
body:
Outcome: the handoff becomes one consolidated block injected at session start (task id, exact SHAs, done-condition command, verify command, every operator request verbatim), and the successor runs the verify command before any other step. Source: .krn/runs/delivery-loop/continuity-research/papers.md (Laban et al. 2025, arXiv:2505.06120: information spread over turns -39%, consolidated single message recovers ~full performance; Anthropic guidance: fresh window rebuilding state from files). Input to t-1tnpz1d; keep one owner for handoff format.
Proof: krn-handoff refuses a handoff missing any of the fields; a SessionStart test shows the block is injected and the verify command runs first.
